concerns.text: Task T004 ('Implement MemoryGuard') explicitly states 'Depends on T005', but T005 ('Create base configuration loader') is listed AFTER T004 in the task order. A consumer (T004) cannot precede its producer (T005). T005 must be moved before T004.

Task T013 ('Save raw residue counts') states 'Depends on T014' (Error handling). However, T014 is listed AFTER T013. The error handling logic (producer of the 'safe to save' state) must precede the save operation (consumer). T014 must be moved before T013.

Task T021 ('Save statistical results') depends on T020 (Block Bootstrap p-value) and T022/T022b (Pass/Fail flags). T020 is listed AFTER T021 in the sequence. The statistical results (consumer) cannot be saved before the p-values and flags (producers) are computed. T020, T022, and T022b must precede T021.

Task T019b ('Primary Chi-squared Test') states it 'Must integrate the fallback logic from T018/T018b'. T018b is listed AFTER T019b. The fallback logic (producer) must be implemented before the test that consumes it. T018b must precede T019b.

Task T027 ('Annotate theoretical bounds') states it 'Must load data from ... stats_{prime}_{N}.json' (produced by T021). T021 is in Phase 4, but T027 is in Phase 5. While phases are sequential, the explicit dependency chain within the task list is broken if T021 is not completed before T027 starts. Ensure T021 is marked complete before T027 is attempted. More critically, T027 depends on T027a (formulas), which is listed AFTER T027. T027a must precede T027.

Tasks T007a-d (Random seed pinning) are marked [P] (parallel-safe). While they operate on different files, they all modify global state (random seeds) in the same runtime environment if executed in a single process. If 'parallel' implies concurrent execution in the same process, this is unsafe. If it implies independent script runs, it is safe. Clarify if these tasks can truly run in parallel without race conditions on the random seed state.
